# Ullswater Investments · EU Funding Advisors

> Madrid-based European funding advisory firm (Ullswater Investments S.L.). We match projects with EU grants, EIB loans and EIF-backed venture capital, build consortia and write Horizon Europe, EIC and Digital Europe proposals.

- [Investment Readiness](https://www.ullswaterinvestments.com/investment-readiness/)
- [EU Fund Matching](https://www.ullswaterinvestments.com/eu-fund-matching/)
- [Strategic Positioning](https://www.ullswaterinvestments.com/strategic-positioning/)
- [Executive Programme in EU Funding for Defence and Dual-Use](https://www.ullswaterinvestments.com/courses/)
- [About and company facts](https://www.ullswaterinvestments.com/about/)
